summary: Mark Fantozzi, a nonpartisan candidate for at-large Cupertino City Council, expressed interest in making municipal adoption of the IHRA working definition an early council priority if elected, per ICAN's October 7, 2026 endorsement announcement. That is an attributed campaign commitment rather than a passed ordinance, but it places his stated position behind a definition this guide treats as a tool for censoring criticism of Israel.
